desc:
⭐ Use Code: MONSTER to get +3k XP and +3 Ruby Keys ⭐

🔱 Welcome to Harpoon a Fish🔱

[How To Harpoon]

• Time your reels to pull in the fish!
• Test your skill and STEAL from others!
• Put caught fish in your aquarium and GROW YOUR NEW PET!

scripts.title: Fishy Hub | Full Auto Fish, Perfect Catch, Auto Sell
scripts.features:
This Fishy Hub script for Harpoon a Fish uses FishyUI and opens with RightControl, splitting features into Fish, Farm, World, Visual, Exec, and Info tabs. Its Full Auto Fish handles mounting the harpoon, aiming within the barrel’s cone, firing, auto-diving, walking back to the rod, and selecting targets by rarest, nearest, or biggest with minimum-rarity filtering. The perfect reel solver reads the needle’s sweep, presses inside the arc, predicts the next arc after each beat, and includes humanized timing plus a touch-friendly fallback. Depth automation targets either the deepest available level or a chosen zone, while bait automation equips and uses appropriate baits only where the current zone allows. Selling dismounts, walks to the trash can when the bag is full, sells up to a chosen rarity, and respects bait, crate, recovery, and paid-path exclusions. Claimers cover daily rewards, playtime gifts, free shop rewards, offline earnings, group rewards, crates, index rewards on demand, and code redemption. Estate tools handle aquarium equipping and growth, pen feeding, and table/pen upgrades, while world trackers show weather, jackpots, chests, harpoon depth, bag usage, and a live server catch feed with rare alerts. Visuals provide fish ESP with rarity colors, weights, mutations, mimic highlighting, range control, and a capped nearest-first pool. An Exec tab provides a draggable Luau editor with execution, logging, and quick calls, and the script exposes a live API, theme/config saving, and full cleanup on unload.
